# Chandigarh Multispeciality Dental Clinic, Chamkaur Sahib

> Dental clinic on Morinda Road, opposite the bus stand, Chamkaur Sahib, Punjab 140112, India.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 99155 10261
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM. Closed on Sundays.
- Treatments: root canal (RCT), laser dentistry, braces and straightening, tooth reshaping, dental fillings, dental implants, teeth whitening, oral and maxillofacial surgery, maxillofacial prosthetics, check-ups. Children are treated as well as adults.
- Google rating: 4.1 from 9 reviews (as last checked).
- Booking: call, or send the booking form on the website, which opens WhatsApp with the details filled in.
- The website is available in English, Hindi and Punjabi.
